text:
Karen Li: Heads-up — noticed a few terminology and link inconsistencies between the in-product docs sidecar and the Console pages. Quick thread to align before we ship the next UI patch.

Mike Huang: Where exactly? can you drop examples/screens? :eyes:

Karen Li: Yep — two quick ones: the Runtime page uses 'Dedicated pools' while the docs call it 'Reserved capacity'. Also the onboarding CTA links to /docs/getting-started but the sidecar links to /help/quickstart. Confusing for new users.

Anya Patel: Agreed — visual layout nits too: the sidecar shows a 16px heading but Console uses 20px. Feels inconsistent. Should we standardize to the console scale or docs scale?

Sam Ortega: From a UX flow POV I'd prefer Console scale for parity with other panels. If we change docs headings we risk larger downstream changes. Can we map the lexicon first and then style?

Luke Barlow: +1 on mapping lexicon. Proposed mapping: 'Dedicated pools' -> 'Dedicated (Reserved capacity)' as transitional copy. Also add a cross-link label: "Learn more about Dedicated (Reserved capacity)" to make it explicit.

Mike Huang: Technical ask: can the sidecar's internal link resolver handle aliases? e.g. link to `/docs/reserved-capacity` and have it redirect to `/docs/dedicated-pools`? If not, add explicit route aliases.

Docs Bot: link-checker: /help/quickstart -> 404 (found during last deploy). This might be why some links are inconsistent.

Karen Li: Good catch — Sam can you open a docs ticket to add the alias and update the quickstart path? Also let's update in-product copy to use the consolidated phrase and include the parenthetical for one release cycle.

Sam Ortega: Will do. I'll open a GH issue and add the glossary mapping. Proposed PR text: "Terminology: standardize on 'Reserved capacity' in docs; Console will show 'Dedicated (Reserved capacity)' for 2 releases, then switch."

Anya Patel: Accessibility nit: the sidecar's close button currently only has title="Close". Add aria-label="Close in-app help" so screen readers convey context. Also ensure the sidecar is focus-trapped when open.

Luke Barlow: Dev note — focus trap is already in the panel component but we pass different ids in Console vs docs messenger. I'll consolidate the prop names.

Karen Li: Ok action items: Sam — GH ticket for alias + mapping; Luke — prop consolidation; Anya — update mock with adjusted heading and aria copy; Mike — confirm link resolver or add redirect; I'll follow up with a short release note blurb. :thumbsup:

Mike Huang: I'll check redirect support and report by EOD.

Docs Bot: Created issue #4521: "Alias /help/quickstart -> /docs/getting-started; glossary mapping for 'Reserved capacity'"

Karen Li: Thanks all — small changes but will reduce confusion a lot. Follow-ups in #product so we keep this visible. :sparkles:
